Giving you the best experience

By clicking “Accept All Cookies”, you agree to the storing of cookies on your device to enhance site navigation, assist with relevant marketing, and analyze site usage.

Cookie Settings

Learn about our cookie categories below. You can choose not to allow some type of cookies. However, keep in mind that doing so may negatively impact your overall experience and the services we are able to offer.

If you want to learn more about cookies and why we use them, please visit our Cookie Policy.

Manage Consent Preferences

Functional Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are essential for the site to function appropriately, and cannot be switched off in our systems. This includes fundamental preferences, such as language, session, and other technologies necessary to assess its health and performance. Allowing these cookies is mandatory for using our site. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but the site might not work properly. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Personalization Cookies

These cookies help us understand your interests and provide you with a personalized experience based on your interaction on our site. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. For example, we may tailor the site based on your interaction to improve your overall experience and make better recommendations for content, products and/or services.

Analytics Cookies

These cookies help collect data that allows us to understand how you interact with our services on our site. This information measures things, such as how long you visit the page, what part of the site you visit and sources of the traffic. This helps us improve performance and content by building better features to enhance your experience across our site. The information collected is aggregated and not associated with any individual, and not used for advertising or profiling purposes.

Advertising Cookies

These cookies are used to make advertisements more relevant to you. This includes tracking the ads you interact with on our sites and on third-party sites. When doing so, these cookies do not directly store any personal information. If you do not allow these cookies, the advertising you experience on these sites will be less relevant to you.

Geolocation Cookies

These cookies collect and store information about your precise geographic location, which provides us with your exact address. When you visit our site we use this information to provide you with location-specific content, relevant area-based offers, and to tailor your overall experience. For example, we may use your precise geographic location to confirm whether we provide services in your area, or if you are within a region where you can access our streaming services. If you disable these cookies, we may not be able to provide certain services or offers to you. If you are located near the U.S. border, we recommend that you turn on precise location to ensure services will not be disrupted.
